description: Source code for command line argument parsing and handling in a native simulator environment, including functions for adding options, handling command line args, and managing test arguments.

methods.name: nsi_add_command_line_opts
methods.description: Adds command line options to the internal args_struct array, reallocating memory as needed.

methods.name: nsi_add_testargs_option
methods.description: Adds a predefined testargs option to the command line options.

methods.name: print_invalid_opt_error
methods.description: Prints an error message and exits if an invalid command line option is encountered.

methods.name: nsi_handle_cmd_line
methods.description: Processes command line arguments, sets defaults, and handles special testargs options.

methods.name: nsi_register_extra_args
methods.description: Registers additional command line arguments for later inspection.

methods.name: clear_extra_args
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for extra arguments.

methods.name: nsi_get_cmd_line_args
methods.description: Provides access to the original command line arguments.

methods.name: nsi_get_test_cmd_line_args
methods.description: Provides access to command line arguments received after --testargs.
